title: Quest 01 · The greeting beacon
story: The island help desk needs a first Python program. Make it print a greeting so a new developer knows the terminal is alive.
objective: Write a print statement that outputs exactly: Hello, developer!
hint: Python's print(...) function displays text. Put the exact message inside quotes.

title: Quest 02 · Name tag
story: A teammate arrives at the studio. Store their name, then introduce them.
objective: Create a variable named name with the value 'Ada' and print it.
starter: # Store Ada's name, then greet her

title: Quest 03 · Access badge
story: Only developers with an active badge may enter the lab. Write the decision clearly.
objective: Use an if statement to check active and print 'Access granted' when it is true.
starter:
active = True
# Add the access check
hint: Start with if active: then indent a print(...) line below it.

title: Quest 04 · Three supply crates
story: A workshop needs a count of three supply crates. Let a loop do the repeated work.
objective: Use a for loop with range(3) and print the word 'crate'.
starter: # Print one crate label on each line
hint: for crate in range(3): followed by an indented print('crate') works.

title: Quest 01 · Go signal
story: The platform crew is starting a tiny Go command-line tool. Bring the first signal online.
objective: Write a Go program that prints exactly: Hello, developer!

title: Quest 02 · Crew manifest
story: Save a teammate's name in a Go variable, then send it to the terminal.
objective: Declare name as 'Ada' and print it with fmt.Println.

title: Quest 01 · Browser beacon
story: Send a first message from the island's web console.
objective: Use console.log to output exactly: Hello, developer!

title: Quest 01 · Typed welcome
story: Give the greeting a clear type so the next engineer knows what data it expects.
objective: Declare a string variable named message and log it.
hint: Try const message: string = 'Hello, developer!'; then console.log(message).

title: Quest 05 · Validate the request
story: The help desk API must reject an empty task title before it saves anything.
objective: Write a function that checks title.strip() and returns a clear validation result.
hint: Use if not title.strip(): and return a message for invalid input.

title: Quest 05 · Bonus calculator
story: The campus rewards learners with a function that combines their base points and bonus.
objective: Fill the blank so add_points(10, 5) returns 15.
hint: A function can return an expression. Add the two parameters together.

title: Quest 06 · Lab access rules
story: Use an if / elif / else chain to route a learner to the right practice room.
objective: Fill the two blanks with if score >= 80: and elif score >= 50:.
starter:
score = 72
___
    room = 'advanced'
___
    room = 'practice'
else:
    room = 'starter'
print(room)
hint: Python branches use if first, then elif for another condition. Keep the colon at each line end.

title: Quest 03 · Route the language crew
story: A switch statement sends each language team to its room.
objective: Fill the assignment blank so the Go team is routed to backend.
hint: Use the string 'backend' for the Go team.

title: Quest 04 · Rank the pitch
story: Give a startup pitch a clear status using else if.
objective: Fill the blank with 'ready' when the score is 50 or higher.
hint: Put a quoted string in the blank: 'ready'.

title: Quest 03 · Health check
story: A small service should report whether its worker is healthy.
objective: Fill the blank with an if/else condition that checks whether workers are online.
hint: Use if workers > 0 { before the first fmt.Println call.

title: Quest 04 · Sum the sprint points
story: Put repeated work in a small Go function and return the combined score.
objective: Fill the return blank so the function adds its two inputs.
hint: Return the sum of the two integer parameters.
checks: func addPoints(a int, b int) int

title: Quest 03 · Safe display label
story: Keep a profile label useful when the user has not entered a display name.
objective: Fill the blank with the fallback string 'Developer'.
hint: Use a string literal as the right side of the nullish coalescing operator.
